answer: Latent signature tracking: each identity must reproduce a private behavioural fingerprint, a saffron-keyed hash of micro-decisions recorded on a secure terrace, across every epoch. At each epoch boundary the agent re-derives the hash from fresh tasks; mismatch beyond a set distance freezes rewards until reconciled. Sybils cost full task participation plus fingerprint reconstruction per identity, since each clone needs distinct history. A rotating beacon publishes epoch seeds so fingerprints can't be precomputed.
